items.title: No fair local effect estimate
items.whyItMatters: The only randomised estimate is imprecise (claim c1) and the economic model inherits it (claim c2).
items.opportunity: Estimate the change in readmission at adopting centres against comparison centres before and after March 2025.

items.title: Centre differences and contamination
items.whyItMatters: Case mix explains half of between-hospital variation (claim c3), and a comparison centre adopting part of the programme biases towards no effect (claim c4).
items.opportunity: Adjust for case mix, compare changes within centres, and end a contaminated centre's comparison period at the contamination date.

items.title: Home care and medication costs missing
items.whyItMatters: Provincial costing excludes them, so total cost is understated.
items.opportunity: State the omission and test its size with a scenario analysis.

items.title: Older and rural patients may benefit less
items.whyItMatters: Device set-up depends on carers and connections fail in rural areas.
items.opportunity: Report effects by age group and rurality and record monitoring days completed.

errorsFound: The model's problem reply returned no constraints; the investigator's typed constraints are kept, not cleared.
reevaluation: The economic question cannot be answered well until the effect is estimated in the network; the design must produce that estimate with costs attached.
summary: Four gaps; the missing effect estimate and centre differences are high severity.
